Which single therapy this patient received. Assigned by a weighted random draw informed by each patient's relative fit across all three arms; not purely random and not deterministic.
Mexiletine outcome: change in myotonia severity at Week 12. Negative values indicate improvement. Populated only for Mexiletine patients.

Oligonucleotide outcome: change in Quantitative Muscle Testing (QMT) composite score at Week 26. Positive values indicate improvement. Populated only for Oligonucleotide patients. This dataset uses QMT rather than video hand-opening time (vHOT), which is a common primary endpoint. Because QMT has a clearer, more stable published effect size to anchor the simulation against. Both are legitimate, real-world DM1 outcome measures.
Tideglusib outcome: combined cognitive and motor improvement score at Week 26. Populated only for Tideglusib patients.
